name: Dragon flag
description: A straight-body lever on the shoulders, lowered and raised while holding a bench behind your head. A strong hollow body comes first.

steps.label: Hollow body hold
steps.cue: Lower back pressed into the floor the whole time.

steps.label: Lying leg raise
steps.cue: Keep your lower back down as your legs lower.

steps.label: Tuck dragon flag negative
steps.cue: Lower slowly with your knees bent and hips straight.

steps.label: One leg dragon flag negative
steps.cue: Keep your hips in line; do not pike at the waist.

steps.label: Dragon flag negative
steps.cue: Take five seconds to lower your straight body.

steps.label: Full dragon flag
steps.cue: Weight on your upper back, body rigid up and down.
